label: policy_waste_disposal_landfill_policy
text: We measure and report monthly landfill diversion rates with a target of 90% by 2025. All departments must track waste streams separately and submit quarterly reports showing recycling, composting, and landfill tonnage.

label: policy_waste_disposal_landfill_policy
text: Our zero-waste-to-landfill program requires facilities to conduct annual waste audits. These audits identify contamination issues and opportunities to increase recycling rates through better segregation.

label: policy_waste_disposal_landfill_policy
text: Landfill waste is weighed at each pickup using certified scales, and data is recorded in our tracking system. Monthly reports compare landfill tonnage against recycling and composting volumes to calculate diversion rates.

label: policy_waste_disposal_landfill_policy
text: We have implemented pay-as-you-throw pricing for landfill disposal to create financial incentives for waste reduction. Departments are charged based on the actual weight of landfill-bound waste they generate.

label: policy_waste_disposal_landfill_policy
text: Construction projects must achieve minimum 75% diversion from landfill through material reuse and recycling. Contractors provide weight tickets from recycling facilities and landfill to verify compliance.

label: policy_waste_disposal_landfill_policy
text: Our policy prohibits landfilling any readily recyclable materials like cardboard, office paper, or aluminum cans. Regular dumpster audits ensure compliance, with fines for departments found violating this rule.

label: policy_waste_disposal_landfill_policy
text: Food waste composting programs divert organic materials from landfill to create nutrient-rich soil amendments. We track composting volumes separately and report on methane emissions avoided through this diversion.

label: policy_waste_disposal_landfill_policy
text: Electronic waste is banned from landfill disposal under our policy. All e-waste must be sent to certified recyclers who provide documentation of proper material recovery and disposal.

label: policy_waste_disposal_landfill_policy
text: We measure landfill waste per employee as a key performance indicator. This metric helps normalize waste data and track progress in waste reduction efforts across growing organizations.

label: policy_waste_disposal_landfill_policy
text: Single-stream recycling has increased our capture rate of recyclable materials, reducing landfill tonnage by 35%. Contamination monitoring ensures recyclables aren't rejected and sent to landfill.

label: policy_waste_disposal_landfill_policy
text: Our landfill reduction strategy includes a robust reuse program for office furniture and equipment. Items no longer needed are offered to other departments before being considered for disposal.

label: policy_waste_disposal_landfill_policy
text: Waste characterization studies are conducted quarterly to analyze landfill-bound materials. This data informs targeted reduction campaigns for specific waste streams like plastics or food packaging.

label: policy_waste_disposal_landfill_policy
text: We track landfill disposal costs as part of our sustainability accounting. These expenses are broken down by department to create accountability for waste generation.

text: Hazardous waste is excluded from landfill diversion calculations since it requires specialized disposal. However, we track hazardous waste separately and work to minimize its generation.

label: policy_for_minimisation_of_plastic_use

label: policy_for_minimisation_of_plastic_use

label: policy_for_minimisation_of_plastic_use

label: policy_for_minimisation_of_plastic_use

label: policy_for_minimisation_of_plastic_use
text: Plastic tape is being replaced with paper-based packaging tape for all shipping operations. This change improves recyclability of cardboard boxes and reduces plastic contamination in recycling streams.

label: policy_for_minimisation_of_plastic_use

label: policy_for_minimisation_of_plastic_use

label: policy_for_minimisation_of_plastic_use

label: policy_for_minimisation_of_plastic_use

label: policy_for_minimisation_of_plastic_use

label: policy_for_minimisation_of_plastic_use
